methodologyNotes: 13 notable baby monitors selected as the 2026 buyer comparison set, spanning the full spectrum a buyer evaluates: WiFi-only smart cameras, non-WiFi/FHSS closed-loop video monitors, hybrid WiFi+local monitors, wearable vital-sign monitors, AI-powered monitors, and budget/value options. Seeds verified against manufacturer pages (infantoptics.com, nanit.com, owletcare.com, eufy.com, mikucare.com, cubo.ai), retailer pages (target.com, babylist.com, safewise.com), and reputable third-party review sources (safewise.com, babylist.com). Manufacturer pages for Owlet, Nanit, and Miku returned HTTP 429 rate-limit errors throughout the session; key specs sourced from retailer listings and cross-referenced review aggregator data (babylist.com, safewise.com comparison tables). Infant Optics DXR-8 Pro specs confirmed directly from infantoptics.com product page (fetched successfully). Eufy collection page confirmed E20 ($199.99), E21 ($259.99), and C10 ($129.99) model lineup. VTech RM5766HD price confirmed via Target search ($189.99 MSRP / $138.99 current). Owlet Dream Duo Gen 3 pricing confirmed at $379.99 via Target. Miku Pro not found in major US retailer inventory as of 2026-06; listed as available on mikucare.com direct. Cubo Ai Plus confirmed at $299 via Target listing. priceUsd = US MSRP for base configuration; where Target shows a discounted price as primary, MSRP is noted separately. specKeys chosen for comparability across WiFi and non-WiFi categories: camera_resolution (string), connectivity (string), range_ft (number|null; null for WiFi-only unlimited range models), battery_hr (number|null; null for AC-powered cameras), night_vision (boolean), two_way_audio (boolean), sensors (string listing key tracked metrics), subscription (string: 'none', 'optional', 'required'), release (YYYY-MM or YYYY or null). accessedAt 2026-06-15 on all entries.
